title: PRACTISE YOUR DEFENCE
text:
the shape of a useful answer to each:

A · Split before fitting preprocessing or models. Keep the held-out test data out of feature selection and model-selection decisions.
B · Names a feature and cites the ablation table, with the change and the spread.
C · Names a feature, gives the measured change, and says it was smaller than the fold spread.
D · Names the metric AND a cost or consequence in the discipline's own units.
E · Quotes the standard deviation across folds, or admits it was not measured.
F · Names one of the four kinds and the specific check made — usually the Pipeline, or the timing question on a column.
G · Linear models extrapolate a straight line; trees follow their split rules to a terminal leaf and give no automatic warning. Look for an answer that notices there is no warning.
H · Must match the contribution log and the commit history.
I · Any specific disagreement with a resolution. Vagueness scores poorly.
J · A specific change with a reason. 'Work harder' lacks a concrete action.

Sample live discussion for feedback; every student supplies their own typed defence in the submitted packet.

title: PRACTISE YOUR DEFENCE
text:
the shape of a useful answer to each:

A · Split before fitting preprocessing or models. Keep the held-out test data out of feature selection and model-selection decisions.
B · Names a feature and cites the ablation table, with the change and the spread.
C · Names a feature, gives the measured change, and says it was smaller than the fold spread.
D · Names the metric AND a cost or consequence in the discipline's own units.
E · Quotes the standard deviation across folds, or admits it was not measured.
F · Names one of the four kinds and the specific check made — usually the Pipeline, or the timing question on a column.
G · Linear models extrapolate a straight line; trees follow their split rules to a terminal leaf and give no automatic warning. Look for an answer that notices there is no warning.
H · Must match the contribution log and the commit history.
I · Any specific disagreement with a resolution. Vagueness scores poorly.
J · A specific change with a reason. 'Work harder' lacks a concrete action.

expected outcome — Compare measured held-out results on the same split. Feature engineering may improve or worsen the score; report the observed difference and retain a feature only with evidence.
